snippet.title: Simulacre Teaser
snippet.description: Simulacre — a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players about strange places, dangerous creatures, and distrust within the team. You do not know where you are or whether anything around you is real, but to escape you will need to explore levels, stay together, and not trust every familiar voice.
